mapper.select: SELECT a.*, m.display_name AS applicant_name, v.name AS agent_name, v.config_json AS agent_config_json FROM agent_hire_request a JOIN enterprise_member m ON m.enterprise_id = a.enterprise_id AND m.user_id = a.user_id JOIN resource r ON r.enterprise_id = a.enterprise_id AND r.id = a.agent_id JOIN resource_version v ON v.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND v.id = r.published_version_id WHERE a.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND a.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
